20170905_075007_A0619BEB.jpg.en: Lying back on an inflatable boat floating on a lake in Tibet, September 2017. My rubber boots rest on the bow, and the still water mirrors the sky and clouds all the way to the mountains on the far shore.
20170905_075007_A0619BEB.jpg.zh: 2017 年 9 月，躺在漂浮于西藏湖泊上的橡皮艇里拍的。雨靴搭在艇头上，平静的湖面把天空和云一直倒映到远处的山脚。
